excerpts:
Sendbox is a company that operates within the logistics and online shopping industry. The company provides local and international shipping services, payment processing, and delivery solutions for personal and business use.
Sendbox serves different segments including offline, online, and social sellers, as well as retailers, brands, couriers, platforms, marketplaces, agents, and franchise partners. It was founded in 2016 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

The Nigerian Postal Service ( ) has unveiled an online customs duty payment portal in partnership with Paystack, Messenger and Sendbox to modernise operations, boost transparency and improve delivery efficiency in Nigeria's fast-growing e-commerce space.
